target_customer: Hospital and health system nursing departments, buying for inpatient nurses
problem: Nurses hand off patients with paper report sheets and verbal reports that waste time and lose information; Aren digitizes handoff, tasks and charting and links nursing work to financial performance.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to hospitals and health systems
product_category: Nursing workflow software, AI handoff and charting

founders.name: Sarah Raza
education: Stanford, BS and MS in computer science (AI), 2022
previous_startups: AWARE, a nationwide nonprofit she founded

founders.name: Umar Nadeem
education: Stanford, BS in computer science (AI) and MS in management science and engineering
founders.background_notes: 2023 Mayfield Fellow; describes himself as a recent cancer survivor, per YC page.

competitors.name: HCA Healthcare Nurse Handoff with Google Cloud
competitors.what: Generative AI summary of patient information for the oncoming nurse, piloted in HCA hospitals
competitors.traction_then: Being tested across select HCA hospitals
competitors.funding_then: Internal project of a large hospital operator with Google and Microsoft

technical_complexity.rationale: Handoff and charting apps with Epic and Meditech FHIR integration and clinical accuracy needs are standard health software with hard integration and compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Embedding in nurse workflow and EHR integrations create stickiness, but Epic and big health systems with Google can build similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: HCA and Google built their own AI handoff app; no acquisition of Aren found.

market_need_then: Nursing shortages and burnout and the cost of handoff errors; hospitals seeking AI to reduce paperwork, shown by HCA building its own handoff tool.

identity.visual_style: Healthcare enterprise site with clinical advisors and a nurse community
identity.voice_and_tone: Calm and clinical: 'More clarity. More time for care.'

rebrands.why: Reason and date not found; the company site says it was previously Kabilah.

branding.community_and_virality: Runs a nurse community and nursing school programs per its website.

brand_strength.rationale: Short exact .com but very generic given-name word; search results show baby name pages. Coverage in Becker's Hospital Review under the Kabilah name.

outcome_analysis: Aren, formerly Kabilah, is an active two founder Stanford team selling nurse handoff and shift software to hospitals, with Epic and Meditech integrations and advisors from health systems. Only a small seed of about 500K is reported by aggregators, no named customers or exit were found, so the outcome is unknown. Large systems such as HCA are building similar tools.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report about 500K total and a seed dated 2024-03-26 with Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund; no press release or Form D found, so no round recorded. The HCA and Google competitor source is undated in my search results, so source_date is null; its relation to the 2024-01 batch date is unconfirmed. Name origin not found.
